Opengeni is an open-source AI infrastructure platform designed to seamlessly integrate intelligent agents directly into your product environment. Its core purpose is to provide developers and businesses with a robust, scalable foundation for deploying AI agents that can interact with users and systems in real-time, while maintaining session durability and operational safety. By offering both a managed cloud service and the option to self-host, Opengeni caters to a wide range of deployment preferences, from startups seeking quick integration to enterprises requiring full control over their AI infrastructure. It includes streaming capabilities that allow agents [...] How does Opengeni work?

Opengeni works by providing a full-stack infrastructure where AI agents can be deployed and managed. It handles streaming responses, maintains durable sessions for ongoing conversations, executes code safely in sandboxes, and offers React components for embedding agents into web apps. Users can run Opengeni on the cloud or self-host it to suit their needs.

Opengeni

### Production-ready self-hostable agentic service.

Durable sessions · human approvals · governed memory · your choice of compute

Start free at app.opengeni.ai →

Quickstart · Docs · Self-host · Issues

CI npm License: Apache-2.0

Opengeni is a production-ready agentic service: it runs AI agents that do real work, keeps a session going for hours or days, records every step in a replayable event log, stops for a human when an action needs approval, and puts each session either in a managed sandbox or directly on a machine you own.
